Asha (CS): Flagging NovaClinic renewal ~4 weeks out. Usage collapsed ~58% in last 30d. Active seats 20 -> 7. Champion left last month.

Ben (CSM): Any telemetry pointing to errors or auth changes?

Asha (CS): No error spike. Console shows embeddings down 65%, gen tokens down 50%. Procurement mentioned a 2-week trial with LumenAI starting last week.

Carmen (RevOps): Billing confirms drop. No billing disputes. I can propose a short concession if we run a controlled POC.

Diego (Eng): Suggest objective bake-off: shared 700-doc set, identical prompts, precision@5 + avg cosine gap, and tail latency. I can provide the harness.

Ben (CSM): Action items: 1) Offer 10-day Dedicated-lite trial; 2) Run bake-off with results in shared folder; 3) Draft retention offer (enablement credit + trial discount). I'll own outreach.

Carmen (RevOps): Drafting pricing addendum: 25% off embeddings for trial + $7k enablement credit on 12mo conversion. Will loop in finance.

Diego (Eng): Pushed bench at commit e7b9. Link: https://redwood.internal/nova/bakeoff. Snippet to reproduce:
```
python bench/run.py --data nova_700.json --model rwd-embed-compact --batch 128
```

ops-bot: Trial instance provisioned: nova-dedicated-poc-01 (expires in 10 days).

Asha (CS): Ben, include new stakeholders in invite: Maia (Head of Data), Tyler (Procurement). Set kickoff next Wed 11am PT.

Ben (CSM): Invite sent. Target success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.75, 95th pct latency <= 130ms.

Asha (CS): If competitor matches quality at materially lower price, we'll be ready to offer a short-term credit + a prioritized onboarding package.

Carmen (RevOps): I'll finalize concession wording by EOD.

Diego (Eng): I'll standby to run additional logs during the POC.

Ben (CSM): Thanks team — reconvene after bake-off with results and playbook.
